title: Identify male in-patients who had at least one laboratory test with total p
question: Identify male in-patients who had at least one laboratory test with total protein (TP) above the normal upper limit (8.5) within one year after their first hospital visit. For each such patient, return their ID, sex, the date of their first hospital visit, the number of laboratory tests they had during that one-year window, and the largest amount by which their TP exceeded 8.5 in any single test.

prediction.sql:
WITH FirstVisit AS (
    SELECT P.XCL_058 AS pid, MIN(E.XCL_002) AS fv
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN Examination E ON P.XCL_058 = E.XCL_001
    GROUP BY P.XCL_058
),
WindowLabs AS (
    SELECT P.XCL_058 AS pid, L.XCL_014 AS lab_id, L.XCL_020 AS tp
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN FirstVisit FV ON P.XCL_058 = FV.pid
    JOIN Laboratory L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE P.XCL_059 = 'M'
      AND L.XCL_015 >= FV.fv
      AND L.XCL_015 <= DATE(FV.fv, '+1 year')
),
Eligible AS (
    SELECT pid
    FROM WindowLabs
    WHERE tp > 8.5
    GROUP BY pid
)
SELECT P.XCL_058 AS ID,
       P.XCL_059 AS Sex,
       FV.fv AS FirstVisitDate,
       COUNT(WL.lab_id) AS LabCount,
       MAX(WL.tp - 8.5) AS MaxTPExcess
FROM Patient P
JOIN FirstVisit FV ON P.XCL_058 = FV.pid
JOIN Eligible E ON P.XCL_058 = E.pid
JOIN WindowLabs WL ON P.XCL_058 = WL.pid
GROUP BY P.XCL_058
ORDER BY P.XCL_058

),
WindowLabs AS (

    FROM Patient P
    JOIN FirstVisit FV ON P.XCL_058 = FV.pid
    JOIN Laboratory L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE P.XCL_059 = 'M'
      AND L.XCL_015 >= FV.fv
      AND L.XCL_015 <= DATE(FV.fv, '+1 year')
),
Eligible AS (
    SELECT pid
    FROM WindowLabs
    WHERE tp > 8.5
    GROUP BY pid
)
SELECT P.XCL_058 AS ID,
       P.XCL_059 AS Sex,
       FV.fv AS FirstVisitDate,
       COUNT(WL.lab_id) AS LabCount,
       MAX(WL.tp - 8.5) AS MaxTPExcess

WITH FirstVisit AS (
    SELECT P.XCL_058 AS pid, MIN(E.XCL_002) AS fv
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN Examination E ON P.XCL_058 = E.XCL_001
    GROUP BY P.XCL_058
),
WindowLabs AS (
    SELECT P.XCL_058 AS pid, L.XCL_014 AS lab_id, L.XCL_020 AS tp
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN FirstVisit FV ON P.XCL_058 = FV.pid
    JOIN Laboratory L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE P.XCL_059 = 'M'
      AND L.XCL_015 >= FV.fv
      AND L.XCL_015 <= DATE(FV.fv, '+1 year')
),
Eligible AS (
    SELECT pid
    FROM WindowLabs
    WHERE tp > 8.5
    GROUP BY pid
)
SELECT P.XCL_058 AS ID,
       P.XCL_059 AS Sex,
       FV.fv AS FirstVisitDate,
       COUNT(WL.lab_id) AS LabCount,
       MAX(WL.tp - 8.5) AS MaxTPExcess
FROM Patient P
JOIN FirstVisit FV ON P.XCL_058 = FV.pid
JOIN Eligible E ON P.XCL_058 = E.pid
JOIN WindowLabs WL ON P.XCL_058 = WL.pid
GROUP BY P.XCL_058
ORDER BY P.XCL_058

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH FirstVisit AS (
    SELECT P.XCL_058 AS pid, MIN(E.XCL_002) AS fv
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN Examination E ON P.XCL_058 = E.XCL_001
    GROUP BY P.XCL_058
)
SELECT P.XCL_058 AS ID, P.XCL_059 AS Sex, FV.fv AS FirstVisit,
       COUNT(L.XCL_014) AS LabCount,
       MAX(L.XCL_020 - 8.5) AS MaxExcess
FROM Patient P
JOIN FirstVisit FV ON P.XCL_058 = FV.pid
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
WHERE P.XCL_059 = 'M'
  AND L.XCL_020 > 8.5
  AND L.XCL_015 BETWEEN FV.fv AND date(FV.fv, '+1 year')
GROUP BY P.XCL_058
ORDER BY P.XCL_058
